lens: GROWTH LEAD (commerce). Does Variation 3 sell the right stock (Ruby, the five bestsellers, Edition Two, deep unsold stock, sets) to the right buyer (women 35-54, Maharashtra 46%, gifting and self, 57% COD) at the right time (Karwa Chauth to Diwali to Bhaubeej to the 21 Nov muhurats, gift posts inside the 3-5 working-day window, 12:00-21:00 order hours), with a clear path to purchase (piece legible on the cover, name, live price and URL on every end card, the exact BUY2/BUY3 line, COD and insured shipping, baskets that lift the 69% single-piece order), and does it earn reach after 76 silent days (reels that hold a non-follower in the first 1-3 s, sends, saves, comments)? Ten criteria scored 1-10: C1 right stock; C2 right buyer; C3 right time; C4 covers and end cards; C5 captions and baskets; C6 reach (reel hook, loop, sound, reel/carousel mix); C7 sends, saves and comments; C8 proof and trust (exact facts, packaging, claims hygiene); C9 ship-ability (renderer readiness, AI plates, cut-outs, fragility); C10 grid as storefront (what an ad visitor sees and buys from the finished profile). Data that weighs on every score: feed and Stories stills earned 84% of attributed purchases and paid Reels 10% (ROAS 0.49), so a motion feed must still sell through carousel loops and end cards; the Ruby baguette bracelet is the best creative ever run (Rs 335 per purchase) and 8 of 13 sales since 16 Oct; packaging/unboxing and sketching are the only topics that ever broke out organically. For reference I re-scored the fixed options on the same rubric: A Matching Centre about 80, B MANGAL about 76.

scores.proposal: v3-proposal-free.json · NAIRA NIWAS (one building, one window a post)
scores.criteria: C1 right stock 7: Ruby leads P1 (188 px in the grid) and Prism is on P3's cover, Edition Two supplies 8 heroes and deep stock moves (Silk Mesh 40/0, Kiss Knot 40/0, Marquise 40/1, necklace 70/0), but Woven Gold Hoops (#1 by units) and Heartbead never get a cover, the Diwali Sunday-noon slot goes to Riviere Eternal (1 sold), the Bhaubeej send slot to the Droplet Open Cuff (10 per metal, 0 sold), and the top-left finale drops the hero stone for green. C2 right buyer 9: present-day housing-society life of the 35-54 Mumbai/Nashik woman (watchman, notice by the lift, spare-key neighbour, kahi nako), gifting and self-purchase both, 'signed for by you' speaks to COD. C3 right time 8: gift guide Sun 1 Nov noon, Bhaubeej 3 Nov (8 days early), Karwa Chauth eve, Padwa self-gift, a sangeet reel and the set on the Sunday after the first muhurat; all inside the order window. C4 covers and end cards 8: the same C-ENDCARD (wordmark plate, name, live price, URL) on all twelve; pieces at true relative scale read well (P1 bracelet 188 px, P12 necklace about 150 x 200 px in the grid); headline-as-object covers (BACK IN 5 MINUTES, LOST: ONE EARRING at 54 px). C5 captions and baskets 9: the exact BUY2/BUY3 line in 7 captions (best of the four V3s), a basket built into 7 posts (four gifts, 'one on each wrist', 'wear both, knots on top', 'get her her own', mismatch, the set), COD and insured shipping on P1/P3/P12 and the site's WhatsApp gifting line on P3. C6 reach 8: 6 reels + 6 moving carousels (the right balance for a buyer who buys from stills); every reel opens on the whole building at one third scale, which is the profile grid itself, so reach converts into profile visits; calm foley signature. C7 sends, saves, comments 9: a tag prompt on nearly every post (spare key, window seat, kahi nako, the neighbour who will ask, the cousin who runs rehearsals), a recurring cast of flats that gives followers a reason to return. C8 proof and trust 7: listing facts throughout (2.5 cm cuff opening, hinged snap 'as listed', shell-pearl care), the real box twice; but 'emerald-green' breaks the brief's never-'emerald' rule, 'made to stay gold.' sits in the Dhanteras caption, and typed 'NAIRA NIWAS / NAIRA PETITE' on plates risks reading as a second logo. C9 ship-ability 7: one C-WORLD file and twelve bay components, built directly on the tested kit/motion/demo.html shopfront; 18 AI plates (about 20 credits), 3 new cut-outs; the three.js box render through SwiftShader is an avoidable risk; the building only reads if all twelve go up in order with zero pins. C10 grid as storefront 8: the finished grid is one lit building with a kandil emblem on every tile and the real wordmark on the crown over a three-piece set, the strongest profile-level payoff of the four; the blush facade on twelve tiles is monotone and pieces sit inside windows rather than filling them.

P4 WINDOW SEAT: STILL DISPUTED: the season's brother-send slot on the Droplet Open Cuff (10 per metal, 0 sold, Rs 1,599) with no BUY line; the joke is good, the piece is the weakest gift bet.

Maine.' on Padwa) balanced. scores.proposal: v3-proposal-box-theatre.json · THE BOX THEATRE (Season One, प्रयोग 01 to 12)
scores.criteria: C1 right stock 9: Prism opens, Ruby on Karwa Chauth, the mismatched huggies and the finale (three Ruby posts), Woven on Dhanteras, Heartbead on Bhai Dooj, Brushed Huggies in the gift guide, 8 of 15 pieces Edition Two, deep stock given jobs (necklace 70/0, Kiss Knot 40/0, Silk Mesh 40/0, Nocturne trio), a written stock guard on every Ruby post. C2 right buyer 8: Marathi natak bells, Aai and Vahini, Padwa and Bhaubeej, the school annual day, the sangeet rehearsal; gifting and self both; COD appears in only four captions and no first comment. C3 right time 8: gift guide 1 Nov noon, Bhai Dooj 3 Nov, wedding gift 20 Nov, Karwa Chauth at 18:30 on the night; matinee posts at weekday noon (P1, P7, P11) are weaker than 19:00. C4 covers and end cards 6: the programme end card (name, price, fact, URL, ticket) on every post is excellent, but the 600 px box dominates every cover and the piece stands about 300-380 px wide on its stage (110-135 px in the grid); P1, the relaunch tile ad traffic lands on, shows no piece at all (box shut, a line of light). Make the piece the hero of every cover: at least 380 px wide on the 1080 tile (135 px in the grid); shrink the box to W 520 or use the 'stage view' crop on three or four covers so the shelf of boxes does not out-sell the jewellery.

C2 right buyer 8: Marathi boards, Pune's one-to-four lunch, the Nashik Road stamp, the bangle-wala's soap, the money order from Bhau: her childhood lane; gifting and self both; COD and the box in every first comment. C3 right time 8: gift guide Sun 1 Nov noon, Bhaubeej 8 days early, Dhanteras honest, Diwali Sunday noon, the set on the Sunday after the muhurat. C4 covers and end cards 7: the identical cream-shutter end card on all twelve (wordmark, name, material, live price, URL, plate and a service line) is the most consistent end card of the four; but each cover stacks board, pati, plate and facade around a piece in a window (the hoop about 94 px, the Prism about 100 px behind jar glass in the grid). beats_A_and_B: Reference: on this rubric A (Matching Centre, fixed) scores about 80 and B (MANGAL, fixed) about 76. A is a stills feed that sells superbly (6 BUY captions, Ruby top-left, the neckline guide, WhatsApp counter) but has 2 reels; B is funnier and sendable but heavier to build. The V3 bar is therefore: match A's selling discipline and add the reach A cannot get. NAIRA NIWAS (80): BEATS B; MATCHES A AND BEATS IT ONCE FIXED. It is the only V3 whose captions sell like A's (BUY line on 7 posts, a basket on 7, COD, the site's WhatsApp gifting line, the real box), and it adds what A lacks: every post moves, 6 reels open on the profile grid itself so Reels reach turns into profile visits, and the finished grid becomes one building. It loses to A on stock placement (Woven and Heartbead never on a cover, Diwali and Bhaubeej on unproven pieces, a green finale where A closes on Ruby) and on the 'emerald-green' wording; fix those and it clears both. DRAWN FROM LIFE (79): BEATS B; TIES A. It places stock and timing better than either (Ruby Bhaubeej hint 8 days early, the neckline guide on the Sunday before the muhurat, all five bestsellers on covers) and has the strongest sends and saves; it loses to A on the offer (BUY line on 4 captions, COD barely present), on a slow reel hook (blank page at frame 0, piece at 7-10 s) and on build risk (13 AI hand/body plates). With the hook, offer and plate fixes it beats both, but its fixes are structural rather than copy. THE BOX THEATRE (77): BEATS B, DOES NOT BEAT A. Best stock and basket storytelling and the truest reach logic (unboxing is the only topic that ever broke out, and the box is the one object buyer, site and feed share), built on an existing prototype; but a product-free relaunch cover, pieces dwarfed by the box on every cover and the BUY line on 3 captions leave it short of A's path to purchase. NAIRA GALLI (73): BEATS NEITHER. The most consistent end card and the best proof devices, but Ruby appears once, the top-left set is Crystal by default, four festive slots go to unproven or thin stock, the BUY line runs on 4 captions, and twelve bespoke facades are the heaviest build.
recommendation: Build NAIRA NIWAS as Variation 3, with five commerce fixes and three grafts. Why it, by a point over DRAWN FROM LIFE: it is the only V3 that already sells like Option A in its captions (7 BUY lines, baskets on 7 posts, COD, the WhatsApp gifting line, the real box on P3 and P7), its reel opener turns non-follower reach into profile visits (the feed stills and carousels that earned 84% of purchases), its 6 reels + 6 moving carousels is the right mix for a buyer who buys from stills, and it can be built from the shopfront already tested in kit/motion/demo.html, whereas DRAWN FROM LIFE's 13 AI hand plates are the single biggest risk of an owner rejection. Fixes: (1) Ruby finale on P12 (necklace Ruby 20; re-read bracelet and huggies on 21 Nov, Emerald/Crystal as the guard) and 'green cubic zirconia', never 'emerald-green'. (2) Put Woven Gold Hoops or Heartbead on a festive cover (Dhanteras P5 or Diwali P6), and give P4 and P6 a bestseller pairing plus the BUY line. (3) 'Free insured shipping · Cash on delivery available' in every first comment. (4) Drop 'made to stay gold.' from the Dhanteras caption. (5) Render the box from the CSS box, not three.js, and lock the posting order (no pins, no extra grid posts). Grafts: from DRAWN FROM LIFE, the Ruby Bhaubeej send ('RED, LIKE THE TILAK. consider this a hint.') as the hint line for Niwas P4, and a neckline-length carousel slide inside P8 to move the 70-unit necklace and the 79-unit Toggle chain; from THE BOX THEATRE, the mismatch line 'two pairs make one mismatched pair, and a spare of each' for P9; from NAIRA GALLI, the end-card service line on all twelve posts and an actual-size ruler slide on P10. If the owner prefers DRAWN FROM LIFE's look, it is commercially the equal: take it only on condition that P1 is prototyped end to end and approved before any other hand plate is generated, every film opens on its headline, and the BUY line and COD run on at least 7 posts.
